title: tour
description: A product's judge tour: the step list in story order (judge-tour.md). guide.js reads it, shots.mjs checks it on screen.

app.description: Short name: the harness waits on window.__<app>.settled; the seen flag is <app>.guide.seen.

phone.description: At or below this viewport width the phone layout applies.

chrome.description: Selectors of the app's bars, dock, panel and sheet. The card never covers them and the subject is framed into the stage they leave clear.

credits.description: Selectors of attribution and licence lines: the card avoids them like chrome, and they never hide.

labels.description: Selectors of overlay labels and callouts, hidden while a card is up unless the step keeps them.

default.description: The app state every step starts from; a step's view is laid over it, so Back and Next are clean.

action.description: What the step performs live: an app action by name, or typing into a real input (cleared when the step is left).

subject.description: What must stay uncovered: a selector, or a scene bounding box [[x,y,z],[x,y,z]] the app projects.

beat.description: Its place in the story: problem, the wow, a feature, the proof, the ask.

number.description: The one number the first 20 s land (on the problem or the wow step); it must appear in that step's caption or title.

captionFrom.description: An app readout name: a live line derived from the same store value the UI shows, never a hard-coded string.

view.description: App state for this step (a camera key, route or toggles); anything not named returns to default.

spot.description: Selector of the control the step is about; the ring follows it.

stops.description: A multi-stop step: chips the card plays through on their own, each with its own hold. A stop's words come from captionFrom, never a string here.

hold.description: Seconds on screen when auto-playing and in the film.

when.description: Selector that must exist for the step to show (its panel has content, its lazy feature loaded).

keepLabels.description: Keep overlay labels up on this step; they must then pass the harness's overlap rule.

last.description: The call to action; its button reads Start exploring.
